image_size.description: The size of the generated image. Supports preset names, explicit {width, height}, or 'auto' to let the model pick the best size. Concrete sizes must have both dimensions as multiples of 16, max edge 3840px, aspect ratio <= 3:1, total pixels between 655,360 and 8,294,400.
image_size.title: Image Size
